name: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship (ESOP)
amount: CHF 13,500 per semester (from autumn 2027) plus tuition waiver
dlText: 30 Nov 2026, 11:59 CET (noon, not midnight)
tags: Apply via eApply in the Nov window
note: About 60 awards for 2027/28; decisions end of March. Applicants who already hold a master's are not eligible. Only the 1–30 November window counts for ESOP.

name: Yenching Academy Fellowship
amount: Tuition, housing, monthly stipend, travel
dlText: 30 Nov 2026, 09:00 Beijing time
note: Two-year English-taught interdisciplinary master's in China Studies. Around 120 places per cohort.

name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
amount: HK$344,400 per year + HK$14,400 travel (2026/27 rates)
dlText: 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 noon HKT
note: 400 fellowships for 2027/28 at eight universities; results May 2027. Get your HKPFS reference number first, then apply to up to two programmes by each university's own deadline.

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
amount: Full cost: fees, maintenance, flights, visa
dlText: 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027, 23:59 UK (set by your course)
tags: Tick Gates box in Cambridge application
note: About 70 full-cost scholarships a year. Your course's funding deadline decides which date applies. Notifications by 8 March 2027.

name: MBZUAI Graduate Scholarship
host: Mohamed bin Zayed Univ. of AI
amount: Tuition, housing, AED 8,000/month (MSc) or AED 10,000/month (PhD) for international students
dlText: 15 Dec 2026 (most programmes; time: check portal)
note: Decisions by 31 Mar 2027. MSc programmes are fully funded except the Master in Applied AI (deadline 28 Feb 2027); Computational Biology closes 22 Jan 2027.

name: EPFL Master Excellence Fellowship
amount: CHF 10,000 per semester, up to 4 semesters
dlText: 15 Dec 2026 (submit and pay the master's application)
note: Apply and validate on IS-Academia by 15 December; references are due a week later. The later 31 March master's deadline does not count for the fellowship. Tuition and rent beyond the grant are your own.

name: Clarendon Scholarship
amount: Fees plus living grant at UKRI rate
dlText: Course deadline, Dec 2026 or Jan 2027, 12:00 UK (MSc Advanced CS: 6 Jan)
note: More than 200 awards a year. Apply to your Oxford course by its December or January deadline; March deadlines don't qualify.

name: France Excellence Eiffel
amount: €1,200/month (master's), travel, insurance; fees often waived
dlText: Universities submit by 6 Jan 2027 · your university's internal deadline is earlier
note: You can't apply directly. Apply to a French master's or PhD and ask the university to nominate you; internal deadlines are often in November or December. Results from 12 Apr 2027.

name: KAUST Fellowship
host: King Abdullah Univ. of Science & Tech.
amount: Tuition, housing, $20,000/yr (MS), $25–30k/yr (PhD)
dlText: 3 Jan 2027 (Round 2, Fall 2027 intake; dates marked tentative)
note: One application covers admission and funding; over 90% of admitted students get full support. Decisions about 25 Feb 2027; classes start 29 Aug 2027.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
amount: €1,400/month, participation costs, travel
dlText: Varies by programme · most close Dec 2026 – Jan 2027
note: Over 200 programmes, including AI, data science and semiconductor tracks. Each sets its own deadline and documents.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum
amount: Tuition, housing, monthly stipend, insurance
dlText: Expected ~15 Jan 2027, 14:00 CET · 2027/28 call not yet published (last round 14 Nov 2025 – 15 Jan 2026)
note: Pakistan applicants apply on both the Stipendium Hungaricum portal and the HEC portal; HEC shortlists with a written test.

name: CERN Summer Student Programme
amount: Daily allowance, travel, insurance (8–13 weeks)
dlText: Expected late Jan 2027 · form opens in November
tags: Must still be enrolled at start
note: Pakistan is a CERN Associate Member State. For BSc/MSc students (not PhD) in physics, engineering, CS or maths. Applications usually open in November and close at the end of January.

name: Türkiye Bursları
amount: Tuition, dorm, monthly stipend, insurance, flights, Turkish course
note: Not open to students already enrolled in Türkiye at the level they apply for. A bachelor's student here can still apply for a master's.

name: Global Korea Scholarship (Graduate)
amount: Tuition, airfare, monthly allowance, Korean language year
dlText: Expected Feb–Mar 2027 · 2027 call not yet published
note: Last cycle was announced in February with embassy applications in Feb–Mar. Watch the Korean embassy in Islamabad and studyinkorea.go.kr for the 2027 graduate call.

name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship
amount: Tuition and living costs: 50% grant, 50% loan
dlText: Next cycle opens early 2027 · deadline usually 31 Mar (local offices may be earlier)
note: For students with no other way to finance study. You apply through the AKF office in your country of residence.

name: Fulbright Student Program (USEFP)
amount: Tuition, living stipend, airfare, J-1 visa
dlText: Next round expected early 2027, closing ~1 Apr 2027 (2028 entry)
note: The 2027-entry round closed 1 Apr 2026. Master's needs 16 years of education, PhD 18. Awards depend on USEFP's budget each year. Clinical medicine excluded.

name: OIST Research Internship (Fall 2027)
amount: ¥2,400/day, housing, travel support (4–6 months)
note: Fall 2027 round: internship 1 Oct 2027 – 31 Mar 2028, results mid-June. The Spring 2027 round closed 15 Oct 2026. For bachelor's or master's holders and students; current PhD students are not eligible.

name: Australia Awards Pakistan
amount: Tuition, living allowance, return airfare, insurance
dlText: Expected ~Feb – 30 Apr 2027 (2028 intake) · last round 1 Feb – 30 Apr 2026, 14:00 AEST
note: Master's only. Needs a Development Impact and Linkages Plan showing how your degree helps Pakistan.

name: MEXT Research Scholarship (Embassy)
amount: Tuition, ¥143,000–145,000/month, airfare
dlText: 2027 round closed 26 May 2026 · next expected Apr–May 2027
note: Via the Embassy in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi; exams are held in Pakistan. The university-recommendation (general) route is being discontinued from AY2027 at several universities (e.g. University of Tokyo), so plan on the embassy route.

name: DAAD EPOS Development Courses
amount: €992/month (master's), insurance, travel
dlText: Course-specific · most 2027/28 deadlines were Jun–Oct 2026
note: You apply to the university course, not to DAAD. A few courses may still be open; check each course's page.

name: Chevening Scholarship
amount: Tuition, monthly stipend, flights
dlText: Closed 6 Oct 2026
note: One-year UK master's. Four 300-word essays; 2027/28 interviews Mar–Apr 2027, results from mid-June.

name: Commonwealth Master's & PhD
amount: Tuition, £1,712/month (£2,000 London), airfare
dlText: Closed 20 Oct 2026, 16:00 PKT (HEC portal; CSC portal 16:00 BST)
note: Taught master's only (no MBA). HEC had 26 master's nominations this cycle; results July 2027. First division in a 16-year bachelor's required.

name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
amount: Full funding up to 3 years
dlText: Closed 6 Oct 2026
note: Separate applications to KHS and to a Stanford graduate programme.

name: Rhodes Scholarship (Pakistan)
amount: Oxford fees, stipend, flights, visa
dlText: Closed 5 Aug 2026
tags: 4 of last 10 years studying in Pakistan
note: Two scholarships for Pakistan each year; no application fee. You must have studied in Pakistan for at least 4 of the last 10 years.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (HEC Type A)
amount: Tuition, dorm, monthly stipend (flights not covered)
dlText: Expected ~early Jan 2027 · last round closed 5 Jan 2026
note: Last cycle (deadline 5 Jan 2026, 16:00 PKT) had 75 seats (35 bachelor's, 25 master's, 15 PhD). Apply on both the HEC and CSC portals. Direct university (Type B) applications run separately.

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship
amount: CHF 2,450/month, fees waived, insurance
dlText: Closed 31 Oct 2026 (Pakistan window 20 Aug – 31 Oct, per SBFI country list)
note: Research stays (6–12 months) and PhD scholarships, not taught master's. Apply through the Swiss embassy in Islamabad (islamabad.scholarships@eda.admin.ch).

name: IMPRS for Intelligent Systems (IMPRS-IS) PhD
host: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Univ. Stuttgart & Univ. Tübingen
amount: Funded doctoral position (amount: check official page)
dlText: 15 Nov 2026, 23:59 AoE (Anywhere on Earth)
fields: Machine learning, computer vision, robotics, HCI, neuroscience
note: One intake a year; start from Feb 2027. Referees must upload their letters before the deadline, so ask them early.

name: ELLIS PhD Program
host: European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems
amount: Positions are funded by the advisor's institution (terms vary; check official page)
dlText: Closed 31 Oct 2026, 23:59 AoE
nextText: Next call ~Oct 2027 (portal opened 1 Oct this year)
note: Decisions late Feb – Mar 2027. Some advisors' institutions have their own (earlier) deadlines, so apply there in parallel. Individual ELLIS-listed PhD jobs have separate deadlines.

name: CS@max planck Doctoral Program
host: Max Planck Graduate Center for Computer and Information Science
amount: Full financial support for admitted students (amount: check official page)
dlText: Expected 15 Dec 2026 (Fall 2027 entry) · applications open 1 Sep
tags: English test unless taught in English
note: The official overview says applications must be complete by 15 December of the previous year but isn't dated; confirm the 2026 date. Bachelor's or master's in CS or a related field.

name: NUS Computing PhD Research Scholarship
host: National University of Singapore, School of Computing
amount: Full tuition + monthly stipend (amount: check official page); +S$500/month for 2 years after the qualifying exam
dlText: 15 Dec 2026 (August 2027 intake; time not stated, submit early)
note: Applications are accepted all year, but scholarships for August 2027 need the 15 Dec cut-off. Outcome about 3 months after the deadline. Other NUS faculties set their own dates (e.g. Statistics & Data Science: 15 Nov).

name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
host: A*STAR with NUS, NTU, SUTD and SMU
amount: Tuition, monthly stipend, airfare and settling-in grants (amounts: check official page)
dlText: Expected ~1 Dec 2026 (Aug 2027 intake) · second round ~1 Jun 2027
note: The official SINGA page couldn't be checked tonight; dates follow previous cycles (June and December rounds). Confirm on the A*STAR site before applying.

name: KAIST Scholarship (International Graduate Admission)
amount: Full tuition (4 semesters MS / 8 PhD) + monthly stipend set by department/advisor + health insurance
dlText: Expected: early track ~Dec 2026, regular track ~early–mid Mar 2027 (last: 3–17 Mar 2026, 17:00 KST)
tags: Recommendation letters due before the application closes
note: Fall 2027 dates are 'TBA' on KAIST's timeline. The early track runs in December, so check in early December. Named awards (Global Presidential, Prestige) add extra stipends.

name: Tsinghua University Graduate Scholarships (CGS, university route)
amount: CGS: tuition, dorm, monthly stipend, insurance · Beijing Government Scholarship: tuition + insurance
dlText: Apply by Tsinghua's first-round deadline, mid-Dec 2026, for CGS consideration (varies by programme)
fields: Most fields incl. CS and engineering
note: Separate from the HEC-nominated Chinese Government Scholarship. Tsinghua picks scholarship candidates only from pre-admitted applicants; each programme catalogue lists its own dates (portal open Sep 2026 – Feb 2027).

name: Schwarzman Scholars
amount: Full scholarship (check official page for what's covered)
dlText: Closed 9 Sep 2026, 15:00 EDT
tags: English test if not a native speaker
fields: One-year master's in global affairs; any undergraduate major
note: Must be under 29 on 1 August of the enrolment year and finish your bachelor's before then. No specific undergraduate field required.

name: OIST PhD Program
amount: ~¥2.6M/year (taxable) in year 1, rising to ~¥3.6M; fully funded for all nationalities
fields: Physics, CS, neuroscience, biology, chemistry, maths
note: Results mid-Feb 2027; entry May or Sep 2027, or Jan 2028. Fully English-taught.

name: Mila Supervision Request (MSc/PhD)
amount: Funding normally comes through your supervisor (amount: check official page)
dlText: 15 Oct – 1 Dec 2026 (Fall 2027; time not stated, submit early)
note: Answers usually come in Feb–Mar (sometimes April). The university deadline can follow soon after selection, so prepare both applications together.

name: Imperial President's PhD Scholarships
amount: Tuition + stipend (£27,036/yr for 2027-28 per Imperial; confirm) + £2,000/yr research costs for 3 years
dlText: Round 2: 11 Jan 2027, 23:59 UK · Round 3: 1 Mar 2027 · department deadlines are earlier
tags: Some departments can't fund international students
fields: All Imperial PhD fields incl. computing and engineering
note: Round 1 closed 2 Nov 2026. Apply for a PhD place and ask the department how and when it nominates. Only for new PhD applicants.

name: UCL Research Excellence Scholarships
amount: Full tuition (home or overseas) + stipend (£23,805 in 2026/27, rises with inflation)
dlText: Fri 8 Jan 2027 (application + scholarship cover sheet; time not stated) · some departments earlier
note: For new research students starting on or after 1 Oct 2027, any nationality. Some departments set earlier internal dates (e.g. STS: 4 Jan).

name: Edinburgh Informatics PhD Studentships
host: University of Edinburgh, School of Informatics
amount: Tuition (overseas rate) for 3 years + UKRI-rate stipend (check official page)
dlText: 30 Nov 2026, 23:59 UK (Round 1; the only round for international applicants)
fields: AI, ML, NLP, robotics, vision, theory, systems, security
note: Outcomes by April 2027. Centres for Doctoral Training (e.g. Quantum Informatics, AI for Biomedical Innovation) are separate applications with January deadlines.

name: Leiden University Excellence Scholarship (LExS)
amount: Tuition reduction of €10,000, €15,000, €17,500, €18,500 or €19,000 (not a full scholarship)
dlText: 1 Dec 2026 (per Leiden's LExS page; time not stated, confirm)
note: Over a thousand applicants for about 25 awards. Applicants hear by the end of March.

name: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
host: Dutch Ministry of Education & participating universities
amount: €5,000 one-off in the first year (Utrecht offers €5,000–15,000)
dlText: Set by each programme · often 1 Feb or 1 May 2027 (e.g. UvA 1 Feb, Twente CS 1 May)
fields: Participating Dutch bachelor's and master's programmes
note: Apply through the university, not Nuffic. The list of participating universities changes each year. Too small to live on: you'll need other funds.

name: University of Helsinki Master's Scholarship (fee waiver)
amount: Tuition waiver of 50% or 100% (mostly 50%); living costs not covered
dlText: 5–19 Jan 2027 (closing time: confirm on Studyinfo) · missing attachments until 26 Jan, 23:59
fields: International master's incl. CS, data science, maths
note: No fully funded scholarships. Fees are €13,000–18,000 a year. Results by 16 Apr 2027.

name: Aalto University Excellence Scholarship
amount: Depends on the study option (check the programme page); fee €15,000/yr in 2026
dlText: 7 Dec 2026 – 5 Jan 2027 (closing time: confirm on Studyinfo)
note: You can only apply for the scholarship inside the admission window, on the same form.

name: Politecnico di Milano Merit Scholarships (Platinum/Gold)
amount: Platinum: €10,000 + tuition waiver · Gold/Bronze: tuition waiver plus grant per the call
dlText: Apply in a 2027/28 admission round · English certificate due by 4 Mar 2027
fields: Engineering, architecture, design (incl. CS and data science)
note: For international students admitted to a Laurea Magistrale (MSc) starting in the first semester. Results 3–4 months after the application deadline.

name: Padua International Excellence Scholarship
amount: €8,000/year (gross) + tuition exemption; up to 76 awards
dlText: Admission Call One: 15 Sep – 15 Nov 2026 (scholarships mainly go to Call One; time in the selection notice)
note: Call Two (1 Dec 2026 – 1 Mar 2027) exists, but scholarships are mainly reserved for Call One applicants.

name: Science@Leuven Scholarship
amount: €12,000 per year for up to 2 years
dlText: Expected 15 Feb 2027 (complete application) · from KU Leuven's 2026-27 scholarship page
fields: Faculty of Science master's (maths, physics, chemistry, biology, statistics…)
note: Second year depends on first-year results. Non-EEA tuition is reduced via a separate fee waiver for some nationalities.

name: Google PhD Fellowship
amount: Varies by region (check official page)
dlText: 2026 cycle: 5 Mar – 30 Apr 2026 (closed)
note: For Pakistani citizens already doing a PhD in an eligible region (e.g. Europe, US, Canada, East Asia, Middle East, Australia). Universities can nominate 3–4 students.

name: DAAD RISE Germany
amount: Monthly stipend for 3 months (amount: check official page)
dlText: 15 Oct – 30 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET · references by 15 Dec
tags: Must study at a US/Canada/UK/Ireland university (12+ months)
note: Not for students at Pakistani universities: open to undergraduates enrolled in the US, Canada, UK or Ireland, whatever their citizenship. You must still be an undergraduate during the internship. Placements announced Feb–Mar 2027.

name: Summer@EPFL Research Internship
host: EPFL School of Computer & Communication Sciences
amount: Living allowance (CHF 1,800/month on an older page; confirm) + travel refund
dlText: 29 Nov 2026, 23:39 AoE (summer 2027)
note: For students from other universities; you must still be enrolled during the internship. Faculty offers come about 4–6 weeks after the deadline.

name: ETH Student Summer Research Fellowship
host: ETH Zurich, Department of Computer Science
amount: CHF 4,000 stipend + travel and visa costs (2 Jul – 27 Aug 2027)
dlText: 1 Nov – 16 Dec 2026, 13:00 CET (via SiROP)
note: For BSc/MSc students at other universities who graduate in 2028 or later. Notified by end of Feb 2027.

name: Mitacs Globalink Research Internship
amount: Check official page
dlText: Summer 2027 call closed (Sep 2026; exact date not shown)
note: 12-week research internship in Canada. Pakistan is on the 2027 country list and all Pakistani universities are eligible; Mitacs changes partner countries each year. Last cycle's deadline was 17 Sep 2025.

name: Koç University Graduate Scholarships
amount: Tuition waiver + monthly stipend for thesis MS/PhD (60,000 TL/month from Oct 2026 per one Koç page)
dlText: Expected: early ~15 Feb 2027, regular ~15 May 2027 (based on Fall 2026 dates)
fields: Sciences, engineering (incl. CS), social sciences, humanities
note: Admitted thesis-based MS/PhD students are considered automatically. HEC scholars can get 100% PhD tuition through the Koç–HEC partnership (apply to both). A good option if you're already in Türkiye.

name: Bilkent University Graduate Scholarships
amount: Tuition waiver, often with a monthly stipend (about 90% of graduate students are supported)
dlText: Expected ~1 Jun 2027 (late ~1 Jul), based on Fall 2026 Engineering & Science dates
note: Apply through stars.bilkent.edu.tr/gradapp. Stipend levels are set yearly. A good option if you're already in Türkiye.

name: EPFL EDIC Computer Science PhD Fellowship
amount: First-year IC fellowship, then PhD salary (check official page); 55 fellowships in 2027
dlText: 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET (main round) · 15 Apr 2027 second round, mainly local applicants
note: Admission needs EDIC committee approval plus an IC fellowship or a lab that hires you directly. The deadline moved from 15 Dec to 1 Dec from 2026.

name: ISTA PhD Program
host: Institute of Science and Technology Austria
amount: Salary €3,053–3,673/month gross, paid 14 times a year (2026 rates); 5-year contract
dlText: 8 Jan 2027, 15:00 CET · references by 12 Jan, 23:59
fields: CS, maths, physics, biology, neuroscience, chemistry, data science
note: Interviews late Feb – early Mar 2027; offers must be accepted by 15 Apr; everyone starts 15 Sep 2027.
